site.title: looot showcase
site.tagline: looot gives an AI agent one key and one prepaid balance for 2,500+ data API endpoints. Below are the open-source apps, alternatives and connectors built on it, each with a price shown before anything runs.

projects.name: looot-crm
projects.title: Looot CRM
projects.summary: Open-source CRM with buying-intent signals built in. Companies, people, a pipeline board and an Intent tab per account. Next.js, Supabase and looot.
projects.replaces: A CRM seat (Pipedrive, HubSpot Starter, Attio, folk) plus a separate enrichment and intent plan (Apollo, Common Room)
projects.costOfRun: About $0.02 for a full refresh of one account, about $0.05 to enrich one contact with email, verification and phone
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/loootai/looot-crm && cd looot-crm && npm ci && npm run demo
projects.imageNote: Demo data, not a real account

projects.name: looot-seo
projects.title: Looot SEO
projects.summary: Self-hosted SEO workspace: rank tracking, keyword research, SERP snapshots, competitors and backlinks, with the price of every refresh shown before it runs. Next.js, Supabase and looot.
projects.replaces: The rank tracker, keyword tool and competitor view of a paid SEO suite
projects.costOfRun: $0.001 per page of 10 results for a rank check
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/loootai/looot-seo && cd looot-seo && npm ci && npm run demo
projects.imageNote: Demo data, not a real account

projects.name: looot-monitor
projects.title: Looot Monitor
projects.summary: Open-source brand and competitor monitoring: alert inbox, page diffs, budget caps and a spend dashboard. Next.js, Supabase and looot.
projects.replaces: A mention tracker (Mention, Brand24, Syften) plus a page-change tracker (Visualping, Changeflow)
projects.costOfRun: $0.0056 per mentions run on four sources, $0.0002 per page check
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/loootai/looot-monitor && cd looot-monitor && npm ci && npm run demo
projects.imageNote: Demo data, not a real account

projects.name: looot-intent
projects.title: looot-intent
projects.summary: Open-source alternative to 6sense: account intent and buying-stage scoring on looot, with third-party buying intent from TheirStack. Ranked accounts, explainable score by provider, cost shown before every run. Next.js, CLI, demo mode.

replacesPrice.text: About $25,000 a year for paid plans
replacesPrice.note: Third-party trackers' estimate. 6sense publishes no paid price. Read 2026-10-10.

projects.costOfRun: $0.27006 per account at list price with all 11 signals. 25 accounts cost $6.75.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/loootai/looot-intent && cd looot-intent && npm install --ignore-scripts && npm run demo
projects.imageNote: Demo data, not a real account

projects.name: looot-score
projects.title: looot-score
projects.summary: Open-source alternative to MadKudu: lead and ICP fit scoring on looot. CSV in, grade A to D out with the reasons and provider behind each. Editable ICP, cost shown before every run. Next.js, CLI, demo mode.

replacesPrice.note: Third-party listings. MadKudu's own pricing page could not be read. Checked 2026-10-10.

projects.costOfRun: About $0.008 to $0.0167 per lead. 100 leads cost $0.83 to $1.67.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/loootai/looot-score && cd looot-score && npm install --ignore-scripts && npm run demo
projects.imageNote: Demo data, not a real account

projects.name: looot-reveal
projects.title: looot-reveal
projects.summary: Open-source alternative to RB2B and Clearbit Reveal: see which companies visit your site. IP in, company out, ICP flag with signals. Company-level only. Next.js and looot.

replacesPrice.text: RB2B: $0 for 150 identifications a month, $79 a month for 300

projects.costOfRun: 100 new IPs cost $0.05 to look up, about $0.08 with enrichment of 15 business networks.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/loootai/looot-reveal && cd looot-reveal && npm ci && npm run demo
projects.imageNote: Demo data, not a real account
